decisive_items: clear cells with abundant multivacuolated cytoplasm, nuclear indentations
response.rationale: Pagetoid spread and clear-cell morphology with nuclear indentations are classic for clear-cell squamous cell carcinoma of the glans; metastatic clear-cell carcinoma is less likely given no evidence of metastasis and prostate cancer history is contradicted.

rejected.why: No evidence of metastasis; prostate cancer history explicitly without metastasis; pagetoid spread not typical for metastasis.
History is nodular basal cell carcinoma, not clear-cell variant; lesion features (pagetoid spread, lymphovascular invasion) are not characteristic of BCC.
